name: awesome-agents
description: Curated AI agent skills and plugins for the full software delivery lifecycle — onboarding, discovery, spec, planning, implementation, review, testing, and deployment.

plugins.name: project-onboarding
plugins.description: Generates focused onboarding documentation from repository code, configuration, and configured external context to help engineers, reviewers, and AI agents understand and contribute to a project.

plugins.name: product-discovery
plugins.description: Product-management discovery and shaping: turn fuzzy ideas and signals into problem & opportunity briefs, a PRD, and a prioritized, spec-ready scope.

plugins.name: requirements-specification
plugins.description: Turns raw inputs (Word docs, Jira issues, stakeholder notes, existing specs) into structured specifications — user stories, acceptance criteria, PRDs, traceability, gap/impact analysis, process flows, and tracker-ready issue breakdowns.

plugins.name: technical-analysis
plugins.description: Code-grounded technical analysis: feasibility and impact assessment from the repository, data dictionary / source-to-target mapping, and implementation-ready frontend tickets.

plugins.name: technical-planning
plugins.description: Translates a specification into architecture documents, component diagrams, and a task breakdown ready for implementation.

plugins.name: implementation-dotnet
plugins.description: Scaffolds and implements .NET backend features following clean architecture, MediatR, and EF Core conventions on a feature branch.

plugins.name: implementation-react
plugins.description: Implements React + TypeScript frontend features following a feature-based Vite architecture — full skill stack covering architecture, style, API clients, data fetching, testing, scaffolding, and feature delivery.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Reviews code diffs for style violations, clean code principles, and security vulnerabilities; produces a structured review report.

plugins.name: qa-testing
plugins.description: Supports test generation, bug triage, and test planning for QA automation engineers. Additional skills planned.

plugins.name: release-deployment
plugins.description: Covers CI/CD operations, Azure resource management, rollout planning, and infrastructure diagnostics for DevOps engineers.
